Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Location, Location, Location]] and [[Ability, Ability, Ability]]: the title of the Channel 4 property programme ''Location, Location, Location'', over a picture of its presenters Phil Spencer and Kirstie Allsopp. A frame at 0:27 of the series 9, episode 4 "Warwickshire House Search", as published by the programme's official YouTube channel.
